diffs.text: As part of our ongoing effort to boost character visual fidelity in DBD, we’ve updated our character materials to match the same physically accurate shading models (yes, fancy math!) used everywhere else in the project. What does this mean? True‑to‑life skin reflections - Skin will now reflect light just as it does in the real world yielding sharper and more accurate highlights. Broader range of looks - Artists can dial in everything from oily youth to weathered veterans, with precise control over pores, scars, and surface oils. Consistent across all lighting - Whether you’re in the swamp, the carnival, or the asylum, characters will look and behave exactly the same under any lighting. The result? More believable, responsive characters that feel grounded in the world of DBD

lines: As part of our ongoing effort to boost character visual fidelity in DBD, we’ve updated our character materials to match the same physically accurate shading models (yes, fancy math!) used everywhere else in the project. What does this mean? True‑to‑life skin reflections - Skin will now reflect light just as it does in the real world yielding sharper and more accurate highlights. Broader range of looks - Artists can dial in everything from oily youth to weathered veterans, with precise control over pores, scars, and surface oils. Consistent across all lighting - Whether you’re in the swamp, the carnival, or the asylum, characters will look and behave exactly the same under any lighting. The result? More believable, responsive characters that feel grounded in the world of DBD
